stories.headline: Researchers directly image how oxide coatings suppress electric fields in working graphene devices
stories.summary: Researchers have directly imaged how oxide coatings suppress electric fields in working graphene devices, providing a new design tool for controlling electricity at small scales. Graphene, the thinnest and strongest material known, is an excellent conductor of heat and electricity. However, its performance in devices can be hindered by interference. A team of Vanderbilt physicists has identified the source of this interference and found that oxide coatings can suppress it, allowing for independent tuning of different regions of a graphene circuit. This breakthrough, reported in the journal Nature Communications, enables more efficient and controlled flow of electrons through graphene-based devices, including supercapacitors. The discovery has significant implications for the development of modern electronic devices that rely on precise control of electricity at the nanoscale.

stories.headline: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max Tipped with A20 Pro, Camera Upgrade
stories.summary: The Apple iPhone 18 Pro Max is expected to feature significant upgrades, including a new A20 Pro chip and a triple-camera setup with a 50MP Sony IMX905 variable-aperture sensor. This sensor allows users to manually adjust the amount of light entering the lens. Other rumored specifications include a 5,567mAh battery and 12GB of RAM. The device is also tipped to have a smaller Dynamic Island and under-display Face ID technology. The iPhone 18 Pro Max is expected to launch in September 2026, possibly on September 12, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro. The new models will reportedly come in a refreshed color option called Dark Cherry. With a 2nm chipset and upgraded cameras, the iPhone 18 Pro Max is poised to offer improved performance and photography capabilities. The upcoming launch is highly anticipated, with many expecting a major overhaul of the iPhone design and features.

stories.headline: One UI 9 Watch Update: Which Galaxy Watches Will Get It
stories.summary: Samsung has started testing the One UI 9 Watch update for the Galaxy Watch 8. The update is expected to be based on Wear OS 7 and will debut with the brand's next smartwatches later this month. The company plans to expand the One UI 9.0 rollout to older generation devices over the coming weeks. Previously, the Galaxy Watch 4 and Galaxy Watch 4 Classic were confirmed to receive the One UI 8 Watch update. It is expected that other older models, such as the Galaxy Watch 3 and Galaxy Watch Active 2, may also receive updates in the future. The One UI 9 Watch update will likely bring new features and improvements to compatible Galaxy Watch models, although the full details of the update have not been officially announced by Samsung. The update's release is anticipated to enhance the user experience for Galaxy Watch users.

stories.headline: The GTA 3D trilogy fanpatch has its biggest update, with over 100 new fixes including restored dialogue for...
stories.summary: The GTA 3D trilogy fanpatch, SilentPatch, has received its biggest update, introducing over 100 new fixes, additional voice lines, and improved stability and mod compatibility. The update, released on July 31, 2026, restores cut material that was previously bugged, including over 100 voice lines in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas. Some of these restored lines were only triggered in specific circumstances, such as during combat. The patch also addresses various issues in Grand Theft Auto III and Grand Theft Auto: Vice City. Developed by CookiePLMonster, the SilentPatch mod is a free download, aiming to enhance the gameplay experience of the Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy – The Definitive Edition, a 2021 compilation of the three classic games. The update is a significant improvement, providing a more authentic and engaging experience for fans of the series.

stories.headline: Kashmir's hardships to India's Test cricket squad
stories.summary: Abdul Auqib Nabi, a 29-year-old all-rounder from Jammu and Kashmir, has been selected for India's Test cricket squad, replacing Jasprit Bumrah for the two-match series against Sri Lanka starting August 15. This marks a historic milestone as Auqib becomes the first cricketer from Jammu and Kashmir to earn a Test call-up for India. His journey to the national team was not straightforward, with his father initially discouraging him from pursuing cricket, emphasizing the importance of studies instead. However, Auqib's persistence eventually changed his father's mind, allowing him to focus on his cricket career. The selection is a significant achievement for Auqib and a testament to his hard work and dedication to the sport. The series against Sri Lanka will be a crucial opportunity for Auqib to showcase his skills at the international level.

stories.headline: Auqib Nabi becomes Jammu and Kashmir's first cricketer to get India Test call-up, inspiring millions.
stories.summary: Auqib Nabi, a cricketer from Baramulla, has become the first player from Jammu and Kashmir to be selected for the Indian Test squad. He replaces injured Jasprit Bumrah for the upcoming series against Sri Lanka, starting August 15, 2026. Nabi's selection follows outstanding domestic performances, sparking celebrations across the Union Territory. His maiden call-up to the Test team has been congratulated by Jammu and Kashmir Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha and Chief Minister Omar Abdullah. Nabi's achievement is historic, being the first cricketer from the Kashmir Valley to be selected for the Indian Test squad, inspiring millions. His inclusion in the team is a significant milestone for cricket in Jammu and Kashmir, marking a new era for the sport in the region. Nabi's performance will be closely watched in the upcoming series.

stories.headline: Harimau Malaya book Asean Cup semi-final spot with 1-0 win over Philippines
stories.summary: Malaysia's Harimau Malaya secured a spot in the 2026 ASEAN Cup semi-finals with a 1-0 win over the Philippines in their final Group B match. The match, held at the Kuala Lumpur Football Stadium, saw G. Pavithran score the winning goal. Interim head coach Tan Cheng Hoe noted that the team started nervously but gained control of the game. The win advances Harimau Malaya to the semi-finals, where they will face Vietnam. The match was part of the 2026 Hyundai ASEAN Cup, with Malaysia's national squad aiming to perform well in the tournament. The semi-final spot is a significant achievement for Harimau Malaya, and they will look to build on this momentum in their upcoming matches.

stories.headline: McKenna rolls past Oliha for vacant IBF 160 title in Irish homecoming
stories.summary: Aaron McKenna has become the new IBF middleweight world champion after defeating Etinosa Oliha via unanimous decision at the 3Arena in Dublin. McKenna, from Monaghan, Ireland, won with scores of 118-110, 117-111, and 116-112 on the judges' scorecards. The victory improves McKenna's record to 20-0 with 10 KOs. Oliha, who is 22-0 with 10 KOs, was unable to overcome McKenna's effective jab work from distance. The fight was for the vacant IBF title at 160 pounds, which was left open after Zhanibek Alimkhanuly's one-year suspension for failing a drug test. McKenna's win was met with a celebratory roar from the crowd, marking an emotional night for the Irish boxer and his family. The victory fulfills McKenna's world title dream, cementing his position as a top contender in the middleweight division.
